item.title: Murph can share context with your group
item.summary: When you explicitly ask, your private Murph can now pass a bounded, verified update to one joined group and let that group’s Murph write the message in the room’s own voice.
item.details: The handoff is pinned to the exact private request, current membership, and group route. It does not give the group continuing access to your private Murph or vault, and a queued handoff is not claimed as delivered until the normal group message path completes.
